name: is-my-box-working
goal: Find out whether this machine is broken, whether it is something I did, and whether it will come right on its own — and if not, what I do about it.
note: Read-only. Every step arrives at a page and looks; nothing is pressed, because this walk runs against the live daemon serving the team (bin/ux refuses a walk with a click step against a live base).

steps.name: the-front-door
steps.promise: Somebody who reaches this machine can tell what it is and how to get in.

steps.name: is-anything-wrong
steps.promise: The first screen after signing in says whether the box is serving, struggling or stopped.

steps.name: what-my-machines-are-doing
steps.promise: I can see which machines are attached and tell a busy one from a broken one.

steps.name: what-just-happened
steps.promise: I can see the requests that just ran and tell a normal one from a bad one.

steps.name: the-model-my-team-uses
steps.promise: I can see whether the model my team points at is up, healthy, and what it is doing.

steps.name: was-it-slow-here
steps.promise: I can see this one model's traffic and tell whether the slowness is here.

steps.name: who-is-using-it
steps.promise: I can see who used what, and whether one caller is crowding out the rest.

steps.name: am-i-about-to-run-out
steps.promise: I can see what is left before something stops working, and when it resets.

steps.name: did-something-change
steps.promise: I can see what changed on this box and when, so I can tell whether this is my doing.
